name: Apopka Holiday Concert with Johnny Wild and The Delights
address: Kit Land Nelson Park, Apopka, FL
paras: The City of Apopka lists a free holiday concert on Saturday, December 12, 2026 from 5 PM to 7 PM at Kit Land Nelson Park. The performers are Johnny Wild and The Delights with their Christmas Spectacular.
The city describes an action packed romp through vintage Christmas and holiday favorites. The same day also hosts the city's 50th annual Christmas parade, which runs from 10 AM to noon.
tip: Pair it with the morning Christmas parade for a full day in Apopka.

name: Radiance Christmas Light Show at TC3
when_note: Thursdays, Fridays and Sundays at 6, 7, 8 and 9 PM; Saturdays at 7:30, 8:30 and 9:30 PM
paras: Treasure Coast Community Church, known as TC3, runs Radiance, a Christmas light show with festive music, from November 28 to December 31, 2026. The courtyard is at 20 NE Dixie Highway in Stuart.

Shows run on Thursdays, Fridays and Sundays at 6, 7, 8 and 9 PM, and on Saturdays at 7:30, 8:30 and 9:30 PM. The church says Redwell will be open serving coffee. The church page does not print a price or an age guide.
tip: Pick a showtime and arrive a few minutes early, since each show starts on the hour or half hour.
